Name: Krobus Relationship Changes
Author: DomTSVG
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WwQZaVc.png[/img]

I was fairly unsatisfied with the relationship the game allows you to have with Krobus. It is not an actual relationship beyond being a very awkwardly close friendship. I was even more sad to learn that Krobus' functionality as a 'spouse' is even more limited than normal. No farm work, no events without mods, and the dialogue with him is limited to not even include as many entries as some others. I was unsatisfied, and so I decided to do something about it.

Introducing my [b]Krobus Relationship Changes[/b] mod for Content Patcher. This mod makes lightweight edits to Krobus' dispositions and dialogue to make it seem more like a real romantic relationship. It also includes a brand new recipe that Krobus can gift you once you are good enough friends with him. All of this without changing the fundamental idea of a taboo relationship with a creepy monster.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgTZfti.png[/img]﻿

[u]This mod changes:[/u]
[list]
[*]Krobus' generic dialogue.
[*]Krobus' marriage dialogue.
[*]Krobus' housemate classification (reclassified to "husband", "wife", or "spouse").
[*]Various text specifically targeting Krobus as Housemate. (For example, trying to start a new relationship while dating Krobus.)
[*](OPTIONAL) Krobus' assigned gender. (Check the Config JSON or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿)
[/list]
[u]This mod adds:
[/u][list]
[*]Some generic lines for Krobus.
[*]Marriage dialogue for certain days as well as more generic relationship dialogue.
[*]A brand new cooking recipe and item, specifically from Krobus (and a special reaction!).
[/list]
[u]This mod DOESN'T change:
[/u][list]
[*]Certain dialogue entries for Krobus, leaving some vanilla lines in.
[*]Krobus' mechanical "roommate" functionality. (Unfortunately including kissing mechanics, which are apparently too complex for me lol)
[*]Krobus' in-game ability to request child adoption/bearing. See Notes.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mcgoSqB.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip/extract it.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]It couldn't be easier! And this is coming from a guy who swore by XNB mods. (I'm a changed man.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C2RzJvB.png[/img]﻿

[u][b]CHANGES:
[/b][/u][list]
[*]V.1.1.0 - Updated to 1.6 compatibility and added a config file. Changed a few dialogue entries and added Void Crostata to Krobus' loved gifts. Added custom gift reaction to Void Crostata. Minor bug fixes (I hope) and general stability improvements.
[*]V.1.0.4 - Corrected a bug with V.1.0.3 that caused Krobus to disappear/not show up on the social tab... Ya boy accidentally deleted a "/" and stuff broke.
[*]V.1.0.3 - Corrected the dialogue with Krobus at the end of the year, fixing a bug that caused the dialogue to loop infinitely no matter what choice was made.
[*]V.1.0.2 - Fixed a bug with Krobus' 2-heart dialogue causing the question to auto-answer.
[/list]
[i][u][b]Conflicts:[/b][/u][/i] Any mod that modifies Krobus' dialogue (specifically any dialogue that I have edited or added) will not work properly with my mod. If anyone experiences any hard conflicts please let me know.

[i][u][b]PLEASE REPORT ANY BUGS OR ISSUES TO ME.[/b][/u][/i] I will fix them ASAP. As you can probably imagine, testing a mod like this can be time consuming and things might slip through the cracks. If there are dialogue errors, spelling errors, or errors in functionality, let me know.

[b]On Krobus and Adoption/Pregnancy:  [/b]Right now it's not possible for me to change the ability for Krobus to have/adopt children like a regular spouse without changing Krobus to a default marriage. Instead, you can use the "debug pregnant" command to have children with Krobus at any time, and dialogue will change according to the config file.

[b]If you're missing the recipe[/b] simply use the command "debug cookingrecipe DomTSVG.KrobusRelationshipChanges_VoidCrostata".

[b]Also, you may notice my Krobus looks a bit different in these images.[/b] That's because I used the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083?tab=description]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] mod. Check it out if you want to!
